name: Nene
quote: The nene (Branta sandwicensis), also known as the Hawaiian goose, is established and designated as the official bird of the State.

name: Yellow Hibiscus
quote: The native yellow hibiscus (Hibiscus brackenridgei A. Gray), also known as the Pua Aloalo or Ma`o-hau-hele, is established and designated as the official flower of the State.

name: Black Coral
quote: The black coral is established and designated as the official gem of the State.

name: Kukui
quote: The kukui tree, also known as the candlenut tree (Aleurites Moluccana), is adopted, established, and designated as the official tree of the State, to be effective so long as the legislature of the State does not otherwise provide.

name: The Aloha State
quote: The name "The Aloha State" is adopted, established, and designated as the official "popular" name for the State, to be effective so long as the legislature of the State does not otherwise provide.

name: Ua Mau ke Ea o ka Aina i ka Pono
quote: The motto "Ua mau ke ea o ka aina i ka pono", is adopted, established, and designated as the official motto of the State.

name: Hula
quote: Hula is adopted, established, and designated as the official dance of the State.

name: Outrigger Canoe Paddling
quote: Outrigger canoe paddling is adopted, established, and designated as the official team sport of the State, to be effective for as long as the legislature of the State does not otherwise provide.
